item.title: Self-Hosted Pub/Sub Platforms: NATS vs RabbitMQ vs Apache Pulsar (2026 Guide)
item.description: Publish-subscribe (Pub/Sub) messaging is the backbone of modern event-driven architectures. Whether you are building microservices, real-time data pipelines, or IoT telemetry systems, choosing the right self-hosted Pub/Sub platform determines your system’s scalability, reliability, and operational overhead.
